record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, change tied item embedding outputs from unit norm to fixed norm 1.25, retaining width 128 and exact zero padding. The norm-0.75 trial regressed; testing modestly larger magnitudes may strengthen recurrent input signals and candidate-score separation under the incumbent mixed objective. This is an embedding-only hypothesis, not evidence that larger norms must improve performance. Preserve GRU topology, history policy, readout, scoring formula, loss and optimizer; use identical normalization in the predictor.
